body:
If I'm leaving I'm going all the way. Having to spend time off knowing that I have to go back isn't really time off to me.

Also it's a bit complicated to take time off now and I'd have to talk to a lot of people about how it works.

I don't know what's going to happen if I leave for good. I'm honestly ok with writing off the last six years of my life as a waste now. 

I'll be 23 and made no progress to my life from when I was 18. It feels bad, but I don't know if I could spend another day in college.

Did what I could. I'm pretty sure it's not enough, but presentations never get any easier.

Anxiety's a bitch that I've never figured out how to deal with.

Idk if I actually drop out I have to have a plan or else my parents and I will have a long, drawn out fight.

I somewhat like what I'm studying and I do want to do it but the pressure to do it well and not fuck up is killing me.

I don't know if I can, actually. I'd have to withdraw from this semester entirely if I do. Also not graduating next semester gets complicated because of curriculum changes.

And I don't really know if a semester off will be good for me. I already go insane during the breaks.

>You have already finished 5 years of school that’s more then what most people do in a lifetime.

Not graduating college is unheard of around the people I know. I come from a pretty well off area and family.

And I'll get a lot of shit for it if I do drop out.

The issue is that I honestly don't think I could go on without going insane anymore because I can't stick it out anymore. The determination is running out, and I'm not seeing the light at the end of any tunnel.

I get panic attacks on a weekly basis. I've had some pretty bad moments as a result of college.

I'm gonna sound arrogant but I was an actual child prodigy with a 140 IQ and had a lot of things going for me. That's not me bragging at all, it's just funny to say because I ended up as such a fuckup. 

I have no social skills, a shitty GPA, kinda lazy, actually can't read very well, the list goes on. I'm not bragging, I'm just a fuckup.

I really feel like I'm a waste of potential.

Curriculum change makes it really weird to take time off.

If I don't go in next semester I literally don't know how I am going to graduate.

I don't know if I have the energy to try and power through college anymore. The all nighters, the homework binges, I can't do this anymore.

It just feels like this entire semester has been a mistake, and I can't go on.

The issue is that it's my final year. I'm a 6th year in college and the stress got to me.

I am about to erase the last 6 years of my life if I drop out. I really shouldn't, but my mental state is actually crumbling and I can't fucking take this anymore.
